name: SPRINGGDS® Shipping for WooCommerce
author: Spring GDS

sections.description:
Connect your WooCommerce Store to all the SPRINGGDS Services you require and manage your orders, shipments and labels in your Shipping Dashboard.

Manage your own Shipping Rates within Woocommerce and synchronize orders, create labels in bulk, create return labels in bulk, use paperless invoices and more to reduce your time spent shipping and increase your time spent growing your business. Synchronize all your channels, warehouses, inventory and create workflows with powerful features like split order, package size matching and much more.

Get 24/7 E-mail Support at ecommerce.help and Chat support at eCommerce Shipping Dashboard

  • Connect to the SPRINGGDS services you use or want to use without building APIs.

  • Sync orders, print labels, bulk print labels, shipping tracking & more.

  • Sync channels, inventory and create powerful workflows.

  • Split/combine order functionality and package size matching.

  • Set up shipment and sender defaults to save time.

External Services

The plugin uses secure Spring onboarding and connectivity services to enable account verification, store synchronization, and integration with the SPRINGGDS eCommerce Dashboard. The following section explains what services are used, why, what data is transmitted, and under which conditions.

Spring / Itembase Connectivity Service

This plugin uses the Spring-managed Itembase connectivity service at https://api.itembase.com as part of the account onboarding and authorization process.

This service is used solely for connecting your WooCommerce store to the SPRINGGDS eCommerce Dashboard through a verified and secure workflow.

What data is sent and when:
– During the connection flow, the plugin submits the store URL, store domain, WordPress version, WooCommerce version, plugin module name/version, business email entered by the store owner, and WooCommerce REST API consumer key/secret generated for the connection.
– The data is sent when the store owner opens the plugin onboarding page and explicitly submits the connection form after accepting the terms.
– The data is required to authorize the WooCommerce store, create the connection, synchronize store data with the SPRINGGDS eCommerce Dashboard, and enable shipping label workflows.
– During uninstall/disconnect cleanup, the plugin may send an access.revoke webhook-style request to the previously registered Itembase delivery URL so that the remote connection can be revoked.
– Order, product, customer, and shipment data may be synchronized after the store owner completes onboarding and grants the integration access through the generated WooCommerce REST API credentials.

Spring Legal & Privacy Information

SpringGDS Terms of Use: https://www.spring-gds.com/legal/terms-of-use/
SpringGDS Terms & Conditions: https://www.spring-gds.com/legal/terms-conditions/
SpringGDS Privacy Policy: https://www.spring-gds.com/legal/privacy-statement/
Itembase Privacy Policy: https://itembase.com/terms/privacy/

Summary

This plugin communicates with SPRINGGDS services only to provide the features required for secure onboarding, store synchronization, and shipping label creation. No data is transmitted unless the store owner explicitly connects their store to SPRINGGDS using the plugin. All data is handled in accordance with SPRINGGDS’ terms and privacy policies linked above.
sections.installation:
• Open a Browser Tab and Register or Login to https://springgds.dashboardlink.com
  • Open another Tab in the same Browser and login to your WordPress/WooCommerce Admin Backend
  • Install the plugin as any other WordPress plugin
  • Activate the Plugin
  • Navigate to Woocommerce -> SPRINGGDS eCommerce Shipping Dashboard
  • Accept the Terms and Conditions and click Connect
  • You should end up on https://springgds.dashboardlink.com with your Store connected.

If this does not work please get E-mail Support at ecommerce.help and Chat support at eCommerce Shipping Dashboard
sections.faq:
Where can I find support if I encounter difficulties with onboarding or creating labels in the Dashboard?

You can receive email support at ecommerce.help and chat support at eCommerce Shipping Dashboard

Do I have to pay for the Dashboard?

No, the Dashboard is completely free. You will only be charged for the labels that you actually use.

Is a SPRINGGDS Account required?

Yes, a valid SPRINGGDS Account is necessary. You can create a SPRINGGDS Profile on https://springgds.com

Can I create labels within the Plugin?

Labels are created exclusively within the Dashboard at springgds.dashboardlink.com.

Can I add multiple SPRINGGDS Accounts with this plugin and the Dashboard?

Yes, you can add as many SPRINGGDS Account Numbers as you need. You can set them on https://springgds.dashboardlink.com/user/profile#springgdsAccount.

Does the plugin and the Dashboard automatically creates labels

The Dashboard provides a Rules mechanism that supports increased automation for the label creation workflow.

What other features does the Dashboard provide?

You can create DDP Shipments, create labels in bulk

Does this plugin support SPRINGGDS Live Rates or SPRINGGDS Access Points?

This plugin serves as the foundation for the eCommerce Shipping Dashboard by SPRINGGDS. Support for Live Rates and SPRINGGDS Access Points will be added as addons in future versions of the plugin.
